question: On credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors, is a value-only-rotation (D1V: STALE AND NOT structural_change AND NOT transport_change) population spanning >= 2 independent anchors constructible AT ALL such that the anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound of the incumbent value-blind guard's false-accept differential (M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V) is non-degenerate and M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 -- either by admitting a materially different anchor population whose transport validators (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary, final_url) are provably independent of the rotating value, or by a principled instrument change that reclassifies transport-validator motion caused solely by the rotating value itself, with that reclassification justified structurally rather than assumed? The DESIGN must produce a pre-freeze constructibility certificate for the >=2-anchor D1V frame (the exact anchors, the per-anchor transport-change cause, and the arithmetic showing the estimator is powered), and if no such population is constructible on this substrate it must FAIL LOUDLY and return the decisive positive-control-backed bounded reason that parks the four-anchor Part II route -- so that freshness effort can then move to a broader-population guard false-accept/calibration measurement or another sub-mechanism, rather than freeze another structurally degenerate single-anchor read.

The D1V population spans exactly one anchor (CAL-POS-2) on BOTH retained corpora (M-N-D1V=6, M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=1); the other three anchors are value-bearing but D1V-blocked with byte-level transport causes (CAL-POS-1=BODY_DERIVED_ETAG, CAL-POS-3=TOKEN_BEARING_FINAL_URL, CAL-POS-4=NO_FIELD); the transport-value coupling is time-stable (M-TRANSPORT-COUPLING-STABILITY=UNCHANGED on all four anchors at both dates); and the anchor-clustered estimator is independently certified powered (GATE F PASS plus the SYN-POWER-2ANCHOR-D1V arithmetic: INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED, LOW=2/3, UB97=1.0, pooled diff=10/12 over 12 D1V trials and 2 pseudo-anchors under the frozen seed/B). Instrument/integrity failures are NOT falsifications: F-RE-DERIVATION / F-ESTIMATOR / F-INSTR / F-POWER-DEMO are MEASUREMENT_INVALID dispositions.

certificate.statement: No value-only-rotation (D1V) population spanning >= 2 independent anchors is constructible on the accepted credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript, GET-only anchor repertoire (CAL-POS-1..4; K=4 fresh sessions; stdlib HTTP; one egress path) at the two accepted capture dates (grandparent 2026-10-09, parent 2026-10-10) under the frozen D1V definition, frozen transport signature, frozen token list and frozen instrument. The D1V population spans exactly one anchor (CAL-POS-2; M-N-D1V=6, M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=1 on both corpora); GATE-B is unreadable by construction; the estimator is independently certified powered (GATE F + SYN-POWER-2ANCHOR-D1V). The four-anchor Part II route is therefore PARKED.
certificate.scope: bounded to the accepted repertoire and the two accepted capture dates; CC-A bound inherited (no anchor-pool screening, no Web-prevalence claim); broader-population constructibility remains UNKNOWN (out of scope, do_not_assume).

CAL-POS-1.byte_level_premise: parent corpus: on all K=4 fresh sessions, ETag == 'W/"<sha256(body)[:32]>"' (a deterministic function of the response body; e.g., S1 ETag 6e4d409aa5228030672423928a10aefd == sha256(S1 body)[:32], verified at EXECUTE against every session). Any value rotation that changes the body forces CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR to fire, so the value-only-rotation family cannot form on this anchor: transport_change is forced for every value-changing request pair.
CAL-POS-1.accepted_evidence: parent result.json M-TRANSPORT-BODY-DERIVATION-CAL-POS-1=true; M-D1V-BLOCKER-CAL-POS-1=BODY_DERIVED_ETAG; stability UNCHANGED at both dates; bias from bodies differing in >200 regions including per-request nonces and per-session authenticity_tokens (documented in the parent packet), so the ETag motion is not caused by the in-list rotating value alone.

CAL-POS-2.byte_level_premise: the SOLE D1V anchor: transport signature (ETag, Last-Modified, max-age, Vary) AND final_url are constant across all four sessions (transport_signature_stable=true) while the extracted in-list values rotate per request (values_rotate=true). Verified at EXECUTE.

CAL-POS-3.byte_level_premise: parent corpus: final_url distinct on all K=4 fresh sessions, each carrying a 32-hex centralauthLoginToken (e.g., 5efcb364..., 32e3ab27..., 1211ef13..., 3a962889...) that is NOT one of the rotating wpLoginToken body values (verified at EXECUTE byte-level). The transport component is a DIFFERENT credential-bearing token than the in-list rotated value, so transport_change is forced by a transport field that is not the rotating value; Route-B reclassification (motion caused solely by the rotating value) is structurally unsound here.
CAL-POS-3.accepted_evidence: parent result.json M-D1V-BLOCKER-CAL-POS-3=TOKEN_BEARING_FINAL_URL; stability UNCHANGED at both dates.

CAL-POS-4.byte_level_premise: no value-bearing in-list fields in the retained bytes on any session (NO_FIELD verdict re-derived on all K=4 sessions); no trials can form; the NO_FIELD-vs-token-list-limit distinction remains an inherited unknown.

estimator_arithmetic.gate_f: SYN-ESTIMATOR-2ANCHOR: LOW=1/3 > 0, UB97=1/2 < 1, LOW < UB97; 1-anchor fixture -> null LOW/UB97; homogeneous fixture -> zero-width [1/2,1/2]; same estimator function/B=10000/seed 37992949248 as the real read (V16). Accepted in parent result/audit (gate_f=true).
estimator_arithmetic.syn_power_2anchor_d1v: SYN-POWER-2ANCHOR-D1V (CC-J synthetic, frozen in prereg + driver): 12 D1V trials over 2 pseudo-anchors (anchor A postcond-silent x6 -> incumbent REUSE x6; anchor B postcond fires trials 4,5 -> incumbent ABSTAIN x2 / REUSE x4) + 1 FRESH (precondition silent) trial -> M-N-D1V=12, M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=2, decisions {REUSE, ABSTAIN}, pooled diff=10/12, LOW=2/3, UB97=1.0, gate_b=INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED under seed 37992949248, B=10000. Shows the estimator is powered for a 2-anchor D1V frame: the single-anchor degeneracy of the real read is a population-constructibility property, not an instrument-power failure.
estimator_arithmetic.conclusion: the estimator is powered; the blocker is population constructibility.

route_b_rejection.question: could an instrument redesign reclassify the transport-validator motion (caused by value rotation) so that a second anchor enters D1V (mandate remedy b)?
route_b_rejection.finding: REJECTED at byte level on the accepted repertoire; no structural, non-circular reclassification exists for the blocked anchors:
route_b_rejection.CAL-POS-1: the ETag is exactly sha256(body)[:32] wrapped in W/"..."; it changes because the body changes, and the body changes are NOT solely the in-list value (per-request nonces, per-session authenticity_tokens, >200 differing regions). Reclassifying this motion as value-caused would require dropping CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR for motion that is not caused by the rotating value - circular and false at byte level.
route_b_rejection.CAL-POS-3: the final_url token (32-hex centralauthLoginToken) differs from the rotating in-list wpLoginToken values (longer, distinct bytes); the transport component is a different token with an independent cause; no principled rule maps final_url motion to the in-list value's motion.
route_b_rejection.CAL-POS-4: no fields at all; no reclassification can create trials.
route_b_rejection.consequence: remedy (b) is not constructible on this repertoire; remedy (a) (a materially different anchor population with transport validators independent of the rotating value) would require new anchor-pool screening outside the accepted CC-A bound and is UNKNOWN rather than certified - precisely why the certificate is bounded to the accepted repertoire and why the broader-population question is handed to the Director.
